bundle.shortDescription: Chat with WhatsApp on your desktop, powered by OpenWA
bundle.longDescription: OpenWA is a fully local desktop WhatsApp client. Scan a QR with your phone, then send and receive messages right from your computer. No cloud, no Docker, no command line.
